memo: Validation run, NO submission (plan audit 10-17, item 1). The a451 base (saddamaditya Apex Synthesis, unchanged) end to end on a fake test: 300 enveda-180 (timsTOF) molecules held out of train.parquet, up to 3 spectra each; c1 half = molecules with spectra in other libraries (only their enveda-180 rows leave train), c2 half = enveda-180-only molecules (all rows leave train). submission.csv is snapshotted after every code cell from the base-list cell on and each snapshot is scored per class (MRR@25, top1, hit@5, hit@25) into val_scores.json / val_ranks.csv, plus whether the truth is in the engine-1 pool. Purpose: a validation that follows the whole pipeline, to pick the next component (ranker retraining vs ICEBERG fine-tune) from the stage and class where the truth is lost. build.py val1 base=a451 val=300 (build_val.py).
